response.sql: WITH status_shares AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share_pct FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), compared AS (SELECT telescope_count, share_pct, AVG(share_pct) OVER () AS average_share_pct FROM status_shares) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share_pct) AS average_share_pct, AVG(share_pct - average_share_pct) AS average_excess_pct FROM compared WHERE share_pct > average_share_pct;
